questions.stem: When particles reach equilibrium during diffusion, what happens?

options.text: Particles continue to move randomly, but there is no net movement in either direction
Particles begin moving from low to high concentration
The particles are destroyed and new ones are created

questions.explanation: At equilibrium, the concentration is equal on both sides. Particles still move randomly in all directions, but the movement in each direction is balanced, resulting in no net movement of particles.
